# DigiStano

> DigiStano provides partial discharge testing and electrical engineering services. Equipment rental supports these activities.

Website: https://www.digistano.com
Headquarters: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Office countries: United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain
Service coverage: United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain
Email: sales@digistano.com
Headquarters telephone: +971 2 5513114
